_why: NIGHT33 builder R (design.n33.kit33 swaps n32-foundry for this file): Tools/night/gen-n33-foundry.cjs = gen-n32-foundry.cjs. NIGHT32 builder A (design.n32.arenas32 swaps n30-foundry for this file): Tools/night/gen-n32-foundry.cjs = gen-n30-foundry.cjs with f9b LAVA BANKS inserted (new), f10 CRUCIBLE rebuilt and f12's ring drawn round. LEVEL 1, THE FOUNDRY (NIGHT29, builder R, DESIGN29.md section B; GG: 'make it fully box better lighting ... don't make up these big boxes make it a unique style that forces the player to use the in game mechanics'). Twelve small CLOSED rooms (a collider roof on every one, doors that are exactly the wall gap), one verb each, pistol / fist / PULSE gauntlet only: f1 move and look, f2 jump a gap, f3 dash a gap, f4 the wall-jump shaft, f5 the wall-ride room (a hazard floor, the lane along the long wall, two husk stand-ins that die only to shots fired from the wall in the slow-mo), f6 rest, f7 slide, f8 the pistol and the charge, f9 the lava lane (NIGHT31: a west wall lane over a 10 m lava trench; with design.n31.unlocks off the PULSE blast also crosses it), f10 the fight, f11 rest, f12 THE LANTERN. Generated by Tools/night/gen-n30-foundry.cjs through Tools/night/n29-lib.cjs; every light is a socket and every prop an authored row. Pars: f1-f3 are the bot's medians over 10 seeds, the rest are estimates (see Tools/night/n29-pars.json). Web coordinates, metres: x east, y up, z SOUTH (the player walks north, -z). Measured instead of the card: the real Mover's wall line climbs 3.8 to 7 m depending on the corridor length (4 m between the walls), never the card s 12 m, so f4 is a 3.4 m deck at the end of a 28 m flue (10 x 52 m, not 12 x 12 x 14).
